name: MRR (EUR), last loaded day
sql: select sum(mrr_eur) from kpi.kpi_subscribers_daily where date_day = (select max(date_day) from kpi.kpi_subscribers_daily)

name: Active subscribers, last loaded day
sql: select sum(active_subscribers) from kpi.kpi_subscribers_daily where date_day = (select max(date_day) from kpi.kpi_subscribers_daily)

name: Trialists, last loaded day
sql: select sum(trialists) from kpi.kpi_subscribers_daily where date_day = (select max(date_day) from kpi.kpi_subscribers_daily)

name: Collected payments (EUR), all days
sql: select sum(amount_eur) from marts.fct_payments where payment_status = 'succeeded'

name: Cohort customers, all cohorts
sql: select sum(cohort_customers) from kpi.kpi_cohort_retention where months_since_first_payment = 0

name: DE MRR net of VAT (EUR), last loaded day
sql: select sum(mrr_net_of_vat) from kpi.kpi_de_mrr_net_of_vat where date_day = (select max(date_day) from kpi.kpi_de_mrr_net_of_vat)
dax: EVALUATE ROW("value", [DE MRR Net of VAT (EUR)])
